channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: An archaeological dig at the Bennington Battle Monument uncovered what may be a historic tavern. Artifacts include a King George the Third coin and mason-marked pipe pieces. The site will be open to visitors through tomorrow before preservation work begins.

One million dollars in funding is now available to dairy farmers in the Northeast. Farmers in New York, Vermont, and New Hampshire can apply for modernization grants. This program covers eleven states to support farm improvements.

Two electric buses sit idle in Burlington after their maker went bankrupt. Green Mountain Transit can't use or sell them without repaying a federal grant. They plan to add hybrid buses and keep these stored for now.

Vermont's Attorney General Charity Clark announced a four point five million dollar settlement with General Motors. GM sold drivers' private data without consent, leading to this nationwide investigation. The settlement enforces stricter data privacy protections and requires express consent from consumers.
